title: OrchestratorDecisionRecord
description: One typed decision the ReviewDecisionOrchestrator made about a 4-review job that ended in [[TASK_NEEDS_INPUT]]. Append-only entry in {workspace}/logs/decisions/{project}.jsonl. Mirrors backend/Services/Runner/ReviewDecisionRecord.cs::ReviewDecisionRecord. Consumed by Layer 3 review and the planned executive-summary surface.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the decision was emitted.

jobId.description: Slug-form job id of the 4-review task the decision targeted.

project.description: Project name as it appears in WatchPaths and runner status.

kind.description: Action chosen by the orchestrator. 'Skipped' covers cases where the fast-model response did not contain a parsable [[ORCHESTRATOR_DECISION]] sentinel; the task is left untouched and re-evaluated next tick.

reason.description: One short sentence the orchestrator emitted as the rationale. Plain prose, no markdown.

prompt.description: Full rendered prompt that was sent to the fast-model session, captured for Layer 3 audit.

response.description: Raw stdout captured from the fast-model session, including the decision sentinel and any narrative around it.

followUp.description: For Reissue, the follow-up text the orchestrator wrote back into the chat log and the orchestrator-follow-up.md file in the job folder. Empty string for the other kinds.
